set.body:
Purpose

Make the delayed-match-to-sample workflow expressible as ordinary ScalaFIM modeling code, comparable in shape to the local fmridesign event_model workflow. The acceptance scenario must exercise that surface rather than hand-assemble EventTerm values, phase copies, structural selector vectors, or response data inside the test.

Required public construction

- A typed trial table is declared once with parent trial ID, run, factor fields, modulator, and phase timing.
- Sample, delay, and probe phases are declared from that shared trial axis; phase lowering retains parent/source provenance without a test-side annotate/term helper.
- One inspectable DesignSpec/EventModel request composes the phase terms, HRFs, FIR width, durations, centering, and missing-value policy.
- A combined formula or typed equivalent supports the four task blocks: sample stimulus, delay load FIR, probe match-by-load SPMG2, and probe RT modulation.
- Semantic hypotheses are authored through the public design/model DSL by term/cell/basis/response selectors; no realized column ordinals, rendered labels, or manually assembled selector vectors appear in the scenario.
- Fit setup is a short public model/fit pipeline; response generation is a fixture concern, not a second modeling implementation embedded in the suite.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The final scenario source is compact enough to serve as executable documentation and contains no bespoke phase annotation, selector-resolution, basis-offset, or column-name parsing helpers.
- [ ] The model construction has one source trial table and one public DSL value; phase-specific HRFs and timing are explicit in that value.
- [ ] The compiled schema still proves exactly 2 + 24 + 12 + 12 task columns and all structural origins.
- [ ] Missing RT, within-cell centering, empty-cell policy, and phase/source provenance appear as library receipts, not test bookkeeping.
- [ ] At-time/window/omnibus hypotheses compile from semantic references and carry design identity/estimability evidence.
- [ ] A compile-negative or typed runtime test covers an empty mismatch/high cell.
- [ ] The same public construction compiles and runs on JVM and Scala.js.
- [ ] If any criterion cannot be met without test-side machinery, split out a focused library API issue and leave the flagship scenario open rather than accepting a hacked test.

Implementation phases

1. Audit existing EventModelBuilder, EventPhase/MultiphaseEventTerm, ContrastExpr, and StructuralHypotheses surfaces against the fmridesign shape.
2. Add the smallest public phase-aware model builder and semantic hypothesis combinators needed by DMS.
3. Rewrite the DMS scenario and executable documentation using only those surfaces.
4. Add independent receipt/parity evidence after the public construction is stable.
5. Run focused JVM/JS gates and record source-shape and readability review in Mote.
set.title: P3.2a: provide an idiomatic multiphase modeling DSL
